items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 11 at 11:02PM AKST until November 12 at 5:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Freezing rain expected. Total ice accumulation of a light
glaze.

* WHERE...Anchorage and Eagle River.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM AKST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Some roads will become slick.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Areas of light rain will develop by late this
evening and continue into the overnight hours, mainly from Eagle
River south to the Anchorage Bowl. Air temperatures will be right
around freezing, leading to a light glaze of ice on area roads.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 11 at 2:00PM AKST until November 12 at 4:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK

items.headline: Blizzard Warning issued November 11 at 2:00PM AKST until November 13 at 4:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blizzard conditions. Additional snow accumulations between 1
and 3 inches. Winds gusting as high as 50 mph.

* WHERE...Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Snow and blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile at times. Periods of blizzard
conditions will be intermittently possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will be strongest on Saturday with gusts
as high as 60 mph possible.
items.instruction:
Travel should be restricted to emergencies only. If you must travel,
have a winter survival kit with you. If you get stranded, stay with
your vehicle.
